백화점.x: I bought clothes at the department store.
백화점.e: Literally 'hundred-goods store' — a store that sells everything.
백화점.t: Pronounced [배콰점]: ㄱ + ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

숙제.x: I'm busy today because I have a lot of homework.
숙제.e: Literally 'overnight task' — work you take home.
숙제.t: Pronounced [숙쩨]: ㅈ after a ㄱ batchim becomes tense ㅉ.

(이)나.forms: 이나 after a consonant (책이나), 나 after a vowel (커피나)
(이)나.m: or; … or something; as many as
(이)나.x: Shall we watch a movie or something this weekend?
(이)나.t: With numbers it shows surprise: 세 시간이나 기다렸어요 'I waited a whole three hours.'

속.x: My wallet and phone are inside my bag.
속.e: Also means gut or heart: 속이 안 좋아요 'my stomach is upset'.
속.t: 안 is the general 'inside'; 속 suggests deep inside something filled, like a bag, forest or water.

맡다.m: to take charge of, to be responsible for; to keep (for someone)
맡다.x: I took charge of this new project.
맡다.e: Homonym warning: another 맡다 means 'to smell', as in 냄새를 맡다.
맡다.t: 자리 좀 맡아 주세요 means 'Please save me a seat.'

상의하다.m: to consult, to talk over (with someone)
상의하다.x: Talk important matters over with your parents first.
상의하다.t: Homonym warning: 상의 (上衣) also means 'top, upper garment'.

용감하다.ex: 그 소방관은 정말 용감하게 아이를 구했어요.
용감하다.x: That firefighter very bravely saved the child.

막연하다.x: My plans after graduation are still vague.

따르릉.x: Early in the morning, the phone rang.
따르릉.e: 의성어 (sound word) for the ringing of an old-style telephone or alarm clock.
따르릉.t: Also the classic bicycle bell, as in the children's song 따르릉 따르릉 비켜나세요.

후루룩.x: I slurped up the hot ramyeon.
후루룩.e: Sound word (의성어) for sucking in noodles or liquid noisily and quickly.
후루룩.t: Slurping noodles is generally fine at a Korean table; 후루룩 is part of the fun.

직위.x: He holds a high position in the company.
직위.t: 직위 is your title, 직급 your rank level, 직책 your role and responsibilities.

폭우.ex: 어젯밤 폭우 때문에 도로가 물에 잠겼어요.
폭우.x: Last night's heavy rain flooded the roads.
폭우.t: Pronounced [포구]: the ㄱ batchim slides onto the next vowel.

행여.m: by any chance, possibly, in case
행여.ex: 행여 늦을까 봐 일찍 집을 나섰어요.
행여.x: I left home early in case I'd be late.
행여.e: Built on 행 'luck, chance': 'if by chance'.
행여.t: Often with ~ㄹ까 봐 'for fear that'; 혹시 is the everyday equivalent.

산뜻하다.ex: 봄에는 산뜻한 색의 옷을 입고 싶어요.
산뜻하다.x: In spring I want to wear fresh, bright-colored clothes.
산뜻하다.t: Pronounced [산뜨타다]; great for colors, styles, moods and a fresh start: 산뜻한 출발.

각도.ex: 사진은 찍는 각도에 따라 많이 달라 보여요.
각도.x: Photos can look very different depending on the angle.

정세.x: The situation in the Middle East is very unstable lately.
정세.t: Usually political: 국제 정세, 정치 정세; for personal situations use 상황.

상반되다.m: to be contrary, to be opposite
상반되다.ex: 두 연구는 서로 상반된 결과를 보여 줍니다.
상반되다.x: The two studies show opposite results.

일단락되다.m: to be settled (for now), to come to a temporary close, to wrap up a stage
일단락되다.ex: 오랜 협상 끝에 두 회사의 갈등이 일단락됐습니다.
일단락되다.x: After long negotiations, the conflict between the two companies was settled for now.
일단락되다.e: Literally 'one stage settles' — a chapter closes, though more may follow.
일단락되다.t: Implies the matter is closed for now, not necessarily forever — a favorite in news about disputes.

확연히.ex: 두 사진을 비교하면 차이가 확연히 보여요.
확연히.x: If you compare the two photos, the difference is obvious.
확연히.e: Literally 'in a certain way': plainly visible.

용두사미.m: a strong start with a weak finish; fizzling out
용두사미.x: My New Year's resolutions fizzled out again.
용두사미.t: Common pattern: 용두사미로 끝나다 'to end in a fizzle.'

강세.x: The dollar has been strong lately.
강세.e: Literally 'strong momentum'. In linguistics, 강세 also means stress or accent.

순이익.x: The company's net profit this year is 50 billion won.
순이익.e: Literally 'pure profit' — what remains after all costs and taxes.

영유권.ex: 양국은 그 섬에 대한 영유권을 서로 주장하고 있습니다.
영유권.x: Both countries claim sovereignty over that island.
영유권.e: Literally 'the right to govern and possess'.

경주하다.m: to devote, to pour (effort or energy into)
경주하다.ex: 회사는 신제품 개발에 모든 노력을 경주했습니다.
경주하다.x: The company devoted all its efforts to developing the new product.
경주하다.e: Literally 'tilt and pour' — pouring all your energy into one thing.
경주하다.t: Don't confuse with 경주 'race' (競走) or the city 경주; this one goes with 노력을.

호젓이.forms: 호젓이 + verb; adjective 호젓하다 → 호젓한 길
호젓이.m: quietly and alone, in peaceful solitude
호젓이.x: On the weekend I walked a mountain path in peaceful solitude.
호젓이.e: Adverb of 호젓하다 'secluded and quiet'; a lonely but peaceful feeling.

외래종.ex: 황소개구리 같은 외래종이 토종 생물을 위협하고 있습니다.
외래종.x: Non-native species like the bullfrog are threatening native wildlife.
외래종.e: Literally 'species that came from outside'; -종 = 'kind, species'.

방자하다.x: He behaved insolently even in front of his superiors.

느지막이.m: rather late, quite late (in the day)
느지막이.x: On weekends I get up rather late and have brunch.
느지막이.e: Built on 늦다 'to be late'; the adjective is 느지막하다 'rather late'.

거시적.ex: 이 문제는 거시적 관점에서 볼 필요가 있어요.
거시적.x: This issue needs to be seen from a big-picture perspective.
거시적.e: -적 = '-ic, -al', turning nouns into descriptors: 거시적, 미시적, 유기적.
